```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
g = sns.PairGrid(df, hue="species", height=1.5, aspect=1.5)
g.map_diag(sns.histplot, kde=False, bins=10)
g.map_offdiag(sns.scatterplot, alpha=0.8, edgecolor="none")
g.add_legend(title="Species", loc="upper right")
g.fig.suptitle("Iris Feature Distributions and Relationships", y=1.02)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
